visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with brown hair and a grey hoodie stands against a backdrop of a scaffolding structure and a blue banner, smiling broadly while making peace signs with both hands. The lighting is bright natural daylight. He appears cheerful and relaxed. (2) The scene shifts to a montage of older footage: he is seen singing on a television show stage with others, then in a variety show setting wearing a black hat and glasses. He is physically larger in these clips, often seen eating or laughing with friends in indoor studio and restaurant environments. (3) Transitioning to his health journey, he is shown lying on a lounge chair outdoors, then sitting in a clinic consultation room with medical professionals. He is seen eating a healthy meal and giving a thumbs up. The lighting varies between soft indoor office light and bright studio setups. (4) In the final phase, he is seen in a red jacket and then a striped shirt, looking visibly slimmer and more energetic. He stands in a studio with bright lighting, holding a microphone. The video ends with him submerged in a pile of pink boxes, smiling directly at the camera with visible dental braces.
